relatedWork.request:
Create a NEW 20-second marketing video for PEPE2PEPE (https://pepe2pepe.fun), starting from an empty workspace. Everything needed is in this standalone brief. Act as a professional video editor and creative director with 25 years of experience. Deliver a beautiful, polished product film: striking hero opening, calm readable pacing, elegant transitions, real website imagery, and natural human-sounding English narration.

PRODUCT CONTEXT
Pepe2Pepe is a peer-to-peer prediction-market website. Anyone can create a question about an event, set fixed odds and fund one side. Others back that side or take the opposite side. Both sides of matched bets are funded on-chain; earlier backing matches first. Accepted odds stay fixed. Networks: Ethereum and Robinhood. The IMD AI agent swarm researches outcomes, with operator review currently involved before settlement. No NFT is required. Explain the simple proposition without cramming every mechanic into the film. Main message: 'Your question. Someone else’s take.' CTA: 'Take the other side.' No guaranteed-profit, instant-payout, changing-AMM-odds or fully autonomous settlement claims.

PUBLIC SOURCES / RESEARCH
Visit https://pepe2pepe.fun and read the product blueprint/interactive documentation at https://pepe2pepe.fun/guide. Capture the actual site with a browser; wait for hydration, currency labels and amounts to finish loading. Show at least TWO real market cards, selecting those most visually clear at capture time. Examples:
https://pepe2pepe.fun/robinhood/market/10 — IMD price question
https://pepe2pepe.fun/robinhood/market/12 — Quotrons market-cap question
https://pepe2pepe.fun/market/3 — IMD swarm token reaching $2M FDV
Use real screenshot/recording pixels, never generated fake UI, invented balances, activity or outcomes. No wallet connection or betting. No local files or private repositories are assumed: acquire assets from the public URLs in this brief.

BRAND / BESPOKE HERO
Official transparent high-resolution logo: https://pepe2pepe.fun/brand/pepe2pepe-v2.png (two hooded Pepes with YES/NO cards).
Additional official Pepe: https://pepe2pepe.fun/brand/pepe-face.png.
Download and preserve the real artwork, wordmark and proportions. Inspect the site's relaxed Pepe/office illustration. Palette: midnight navy/teal, mint, restrained lilac/coral, pale clean type. Fonts: Barlow Condensed headlines, Space Grotesk text, IBM Plex Mono sparingly.
Concept: 'Your take becomes a market.' Start in a beautiful Pepe brand world, move smoothly into the product, return to an invitation. Design a bespoke hero/starter image worthy of a campaign poster: recognizable Pepe, official logo and exactly spelled pepe2pepe.fun ALL clearly visible from frame one. Generous negative space, balanced typography, subtle depth, soft cinematic lighting and controlled highlights. No busy particles, generic HUD, loading bars, neon barrage or template boxes. Background art may be generated/composed, but overlay authentic logo files and typeset the URL separately. Opening must be a complete attractive composition, not an unfinished reveal. Deliver this hero as a separate PNG.

STORYBOARD — 20 SECONDS, 1920x1080, 16:9, 30fps
FIVE principal compositions with breathing room:
0-4s: Beautiful hero, logo, Pepe and URL visible immediately. Slow subtle push-in/parallax. Hook: 'Your question. Someone else’s take.' Hold the composition.
4-9s: One gentle continuous view of the real homepage moving toward TWO readable real market cards with identifiable questions and YES/NO options. Preserve spatial continuity; avoid cycling unrelated screenshots.
9-14s: One actual market's fixed-odds controls or funding view. Purposeful close-up, then settle. Minimal caption: 'Pick a side. Fixed odds.' or 'Funded on-chain.' Avoid crowded menus and extra mechanics.
14-17s: Clean IMD Oracle moment using a relevant real UI detail or clearly illustrative swarm motif. Caption: 'Powered by the IMD Oracle.' No dense documentation paragraph or fabricated settlement.
17-20s: Graceful return to hero: logo, Pepe, large pepe2pepe.fun and 'Take the other side.' Hold final CTA stable for at least 2.5 seconds.

TRANSITIONS / PACING — CRITICAL
Intentional, coherent, calm. Favor compositionally matched cuts after movement settles, or restrained 12-18-frame dissolves between clean backgrounds. Maintain motion direction, visual anchors, margins and colors. Never dissolve dense UI text over different text: transition its container/background or cut at a natural pause, avoiding ghosting. No sliding-picture panels, sweep lines, flashing streaks, whip pans, spin/glitch/abrupt zoom transitions, bouncy easing or random effects on every shot. Smooth ease-in/ease-out; no sudden scale jumps. Mostly stationary crisp captions, generous padding, important copy held at least 3 seconds. No rapid micro-shot montage or static slideshow decorated with effects. Real product imagery occupies most of the middle. Inspect transitions at normal speed AND frame by frame for awkwardness, clipping, double text and blank frames. Refined editorial craft matters more than effects.

VOICE / AUDIO — CRITICAL
Include warm, confident, conversational English narration like an experienced human commercial actor: natural sentence stress, subtle breath and relaxed pauses. Synthetic generation is acceptable only when the resulting performance sounds natural. Use an expressive voice tool, audition at least two takes/settings, and choose after listening where playback is available. Generate one coherent performance rather than stitching separately spoken phrases. No default computer voice, stiff robotic announcer cadence, word-by-word reading, exaggerated influencer delivery or sped-up/time-stretched speech. Avoid Microsoft Edge GuyNeural-style machine tone. Do not clone a real person's voice.
Suggested short script: 'Your question. Someone else’s take. On Pepe2Pepe, pick a side at fixed odds, with funds on-chain. Powered by the IMD Oracle. Take the other side.' Pronounce Pepe2Pepe as 'Pepe to Pepe', IMD as 'I M D'. Rephrase/shorten naturally if needed; preserve pauses rather than accelerating speech. Do not narrate the production instructions. Add original/properly licensed refined instrumental around 85-100 BPM, quiet beneath speech, and subtle sound design, not a whoosh per cut. Captions must make the film work muted. Natural narration is required: if unavailable, disclose that limitation honestly rather than disguising a robotic fallback as meeting this brief.

DELIVERABLES / REVIEW
Use installed video tools and appropriate editing/compositing; check provider availability early. Deliver real files:
artifacts/video.mp4 — 20 seconds within one frame, 1080p30, H.264/yuv420p, AAC stereo, faststart, under 64 MiB.
artifacts/hero.png — polished 1920x1080 opening campaign poster.
artifacts/README.md — sources, storyboard, voice provider, music licensing, tools, actual codecs/duration, honest limitations.
Include useful editable sources within source upload limits; exclude dependency archives. Watch the whole film at normal speed, inspect hero, market readability, every transition and CTA, and listen to the mix where playback is available. Do not claim listening if only waveform analysis occurred. Fix visual/audio defects before delivery. A valid MP4 alone is insufficient: deliver work a seasoned professional would proudly hand to a paying brand client.
